project_info.theme: Techcombank OneU QR payment reward reminder

main_subject.detail: A clean reward-reminder poster with Techcombank OneU branding. Headline says 'Trieu qua dang cho DUNG DE BO LO' and a red rounded button says 'QUET QR NGAY'. A large smartphone at center shows a payment-success screen with the text 'Chuyen thanh cong VND 300,000', 'Tai khoan VND 260,000', and offers 'Voucher 60K' plus 'U-Point 40K'. Red U-point coins float around. A white gift box with a red ribbon sits on a red pedestal. A white popup card says 'Ban co qua dac biet'. Bottom-right badge says 'Da tang uu dai LOI ICH TOI UU'. The blurred background looks like a bright cafe or home-interior setting.
main_subject.style: Clean banking reward poster with app-screen hero, polished gift-box props, and soft interior depth
